notes.text: Of the {total} components, {client} are client components that ship JavaScript. The other {server} render only on the server.

Every scroll reveal shares one IntersectionObserver. With JavaScript off nothing is hidden in the first place, and if the scripts fail to load, a fallback in the page head shows everything after three seconds.
The numbers under Impact are rendered on the server at their final value, so they read right without JavaScript. The count-up only runs once they scroll into view.
The progress line under the header is written straight to the DOM. While you scroll, React only re-renders when you reach a new section.
Before every build, Prunify checks this code for dead exports, import cycles and unused assets. Its latest result is on the Prunify card above.
Fonts are self-hosted through next/font, so the page makes no font requests to Google. The link preview image is drawn at build time in the same typefaces.
